V01.drivers: Typical slim human proportions; smooth chest-waist-hip taper; normal buttock and calf profile; plantigrade feet

structure.axial_section_shape: oval chest tapering smoothly to a slightly narrower waist and pelvis
structure.load_path: vertical through pelvis, straight knees, onto plantigrade feet

V02.drivers: Typical human build, slightly broader shoulders and fuller thighs than V01

structure.axial_section_shape: oval chest to pelvis with mild taper

V03.drivers: Human build with a softer, rounder belly and a deeper trunk in profile

structure.axial_section_shape: deeper, rounder trunk with some belly protrusion

V04.drivers: Typical slim human build, close to V01

V05.drivers: Human build with slight chest/breast fullness and wider hips

structure.axial_section_shape: oval trunk with fuller chest and hip

V06.drivers: Typical human build, slightly broader upper body

V07.drivers: Human build with a deeper trunk and soft belly and back in profile, similar to V03

structure.axial_section_shape: deep, rounded trunk with abdominal fullness

V08.drivers: In profile the chest is a deep keel/barrel that bulges front and back above a sharply pinched waist; narrow pelvis; very slender thighs; knobbly knees with a strong backward calf bulge; long thin arms
axial_cues: deep keeled chest bulging front and back
limb_cues: long thin arms with large hands

structure.axial_section_shape: deep keeled upper chest over a pinched waist and narrow pelvis (hourglass in profile)
structure.joint_integration: abrupt, knobbly joints with thin shafts between them
structure.segment_relations: heavy upper trunk; thin, long legs and arms; large hands
structure.load_path: mass concentrated high in the chest, carried through a narrow waist onto spindly legs

non_structural_factors.notes: thinness alone does not explain the chest-waist organization

V09.drivers: Typical human build, slightly fuller hips and thighs

V10.drivers: Massive, hyper-segmented musculature; very wide shoulders with large deltoid/pauldron-like masses; broad, blocky trunk; wide stance; heavy, lumpy legs; very large feet; profile shows a bent, offset leg line and stray fragments (possibly mesh artifacts)
axial_cues: trunk widening down to a broad pelvis
limb_cues: thick, lumpy arms with small-looking hands
bent knee and ankle in profile

structure.axial_section_shape: broad, blocky trunk widening to a massive pelvis, with no waist taper
structure.joint_integration: joints buried in muscle masses; segmented, lumpy transitions
structure.segment_relations: massive trunk and shoulders; short, thick legs; large feet
structure.load_path: heavy upper mass carried down a wide stance and bent legs onto broad feet

non_structural_factors.notes: extreme muscularity and bulk dominate, but trunk shape and stance also differ from human

V11.drivers: Same pattern as V08: keeled chest bulging front and back over a pinched waist, narrow pelvis, spindly thighs, knobbly knees with a strong calf bulge, long thin arms

structure.axial_section_shape: deep keeled chest over a pinched waist (hourglass in profile)
structure.load_path: chest-heavy mass carried through a narrow waist onto thin legs

distinguishing_features: V08/V11 are chest-heavy with an hourglass profile: a deep keeled chest, a pinched waist, a narrow pelvis, spindly limbs and knobbly joints. V10 is massive and blocky with no waist taper, very wide shoulders, segmented heavy limbs, a wide stance and large feet. Their builds are close to opposite in bulk and in how the trunk is organized.
